in_hebrew.name: Flanagan
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Flanagan הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Flanagan is derived from the Irish surname O’Flannaghan, meaning 'descendant of Flann.' Flann is an Old Irish personal name that translates to 'reddish-haired.' As a surname, it was often used to denote someone with reddish hair or a ruddy complexion. Despite its Irish origin, the name has been widely adopted in the English-speaking world and is now commonly used among people of various ethnicities and religious backgrounds.
